Unsigned

.

Auctions close within 7 days of each other
Are safe to ship in one box without damage
All items must be paid for at the same time.
Multiple orders cannot be combined into one shipment
. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to that order.

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight via Fedex Ground or Home Delivery. We do not use Express or overnight shipping. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight. These are Fedex rules, not ours. We try to ship items the day after receiving payment. Payments must be received by 7:00 am to be shipped that day. After 7:00 am the item(s) will ship the following day. We generally do not work weekends and therefore shipping is not done on those days.
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
We put ADULT SIGNATURE REQUIRED on your package delivery if your order totals more than $100.00 excluding, tax, handling and shipping. Items under the value of $100.00 will NOT be receiving the signature option. This is to help prevent porch theft and to minimize lost packages. We are doing this for you, the buyer. This requirement is in your best interest and at no cost to you. We are paying for this surcharge and it is our way of giving back to you to ensure you receive your item(s).
If you would prefer not to have the signature requirement, please contact us by opening a service ticket to let us know that you would not prefer it
. If you place your item on hold for pickup at any Fedex location that has Adult Signature Required, you will be required to show ID but your address on the ID must match the ship to address on the label.
Regarding lost or delayed packages: If a package has been or is being delayed (non-movement on the tracking number after 2-4 days), please notify us by opening a customer service ticket for your shipped item. We will, in turn, file a claim on our behalf with Fedex for your package. This will trigger a search for your package, if found by Fedex, your package will start moving again. If not found, Fedex will pay the claim. When Fedex marks the claim as paid in their system, we will then issue your refund, not before, no exceptions. This process can take 2-4 weeks to resolve. We check on claim statuses Monday - Friday and will issue your refund accordingly.
REMINDER:
If you place your item on hold for pickup at a Fedex location, you have 7 days (including weekends) to pick up your package. Failure to pick up your package at the hold location results in the package being returned to us. You will then have to pay new shipping charges if you want your item re-shipped. If not, the item is then considered a donation and there will be no refunds issued under any circumstances.
Fedex does not deliver to PO Boxes
. You must provide a physical street address. If you have a PO Box setup on your account that you use, you may modify your SHIP TO ADDRESS when submitting your payment.
WE DO NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS
. We strongly urge users to estimate shipping before bidding. We do not lower or alter FedEx rates and will not cancel orders for shipping cost reasons.

description:
Artist Unknown
Gemstone Bonsai Wire Tree
Wire and Gemstone Sculpture on Quartz Base
9" L x 4" W x 9" H
Unsigned
This elegant gemstone bonsai tree sculpture features intricate gold-toned wire branches adorned with polished crystal chips in white and peach hues. The branches are hand-twisted and set into a substantial raw quartz crystal base, creating a balance between craft and natural mineral beauty. Often associated with Feng Shui for attracting positive energy, this piece serves as a sophisticated accent for bohemian or mid-century modern interiors.
Hand-twisted gold-tone wire construction allowing for custom branch positioning
Features tumbled gemstone chips including clear quartz and peach-toned stones
Substantial raw quartz crystal base provides stability and natural aesthetic appeal
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The wire branches are flexible and intact with no broken segments. The gemstone chips are securely attached, though natural variations in the raw quartz base are present as intended by the artist.

condition. Items are represented to the best of our ability,

completing payment

This is a used, donated item that has not been cleaned, serviced or tested for functionality unless otherwise noted in the listing. All photographs are considered to be part of the description of the item, please be sure to review them before placing your bid. We DO NOT color enhance our photos. All photos are taken with iPhones and under LED lighting. Due to the way individuals see colors, the differences in color computer monitors and cameras there may be slight variations and or differences between the actual item and the photographs. There are no returns accepted on any item for color variation.
TESTING:
All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.
We describe each item to the best of our ability; however, we are
NOT
experts in any field. All gemstones are measured using electronic calipers.
All gemstones are tested on a Presidium Gemstone Tester. This equipment CANNOT determine between natural, lab created and synthetic gemstones. There are no returns accepted for lab created or synthetic gemstones.
Items may be vintage, antique or newer. There is still a chance that the stones can become loose or that a connector may need to be tightened. We are as delicate as possible with the items, but there is a possibility we may miss the flaw or that it may happen during shipment. No refunds permitted or given for gemstones that become dislodged from their setting in or during shipment.
TERMINOLOGY USED IN OUR LISTINGS:
The definition of the word
stone(s)
can be anything at all. It is only being used as more of a descriptive word/placeholder. These can be anything from genuine gemstone, lab created, synthetic, glass, plastic or crystal "stones". Unless specifically stated as gemstone(s) there will be no returns accepted for jewelry where the word "stone(s)" is used in our listing. Please make sure you understand and take that into account before placing a bid.
Pearls are tested to the best of our ability for texture and layering. They are not professionally tested. Pearls that do not pass the texture and layering test are labeled "faux". The approximate diameter is provided for size only, and the pearl(s) may or may not be perfectly round. 90% of the world's pearls are now cultured and are not naturally occurring. We cannot distinguish between cultured and natural pearls. You are bidding with this knowledge in mind.
Color, when we describe the color (of a stone, gem, bead, or anything that is described by a color), we may have different lighting than you & some of us see colors differently. Please know that the color that is described could be slightly different & a return will not be accepted for this reason.
Amber is determined to be an organic by-product (ie not plastic) and we cannot make any statement as to age or if it has fossilized.
Bakelite has been identified via the scrubbing bubbles test or metal polish.

Natural Crystal and Dyed Agate

This decorative three-piece gemstone set features a prominent amethyst crystal cluster and two polished agate geode halves. The amethyst specimen showcases a dense grouping of purple terminations emerging from a natural matrix base. The two agate pieces have been treated with a vibrant teal dye to highlight the natural concentric banding and quartz crystalline centers, which contrast sharply against the rough, earth-toned outer rinds. These pieces function excellently as shelf accents or organic decorative elements in a modernist or eclectic interior.
Amethyst cluster features natural prismatic crystal points with varying violet saturation
Agate slices exhibit polished faces revealing intricate geode interiors and quartz structures
Versatile sizes suitable for shelf display, desk accents, or as decorative bookends
Largest agate specimen measures approximately 5.5" in width based on visual scale
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As geological specimens, these items feature inherent variations in color, texture, and crystal formation. The teal coloration in the agate is an enhancement; both agate pieces and the amethyst cluster are structurally sound with no significant damage beyond natural geological inclusions.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

Description
: Dive into nostalgia with this large collection of vintage POGs milk caps and slammers, conveniently stored in two labeled tubes.
